body.statement: For every \(q\in(0,1)\), uniformly over \(P\in\mathcal P_K^{\cup}\), \(P\{|\widehat d_{\rm sp}-d(P)|\le t_q\}\ge1-q\). With \(t_\alpha=t_q\vert_{q=\alpha}\), consequently \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_K^{\cup}:d(P)=0}E_P\phi_{\rm sp}\le\alpha\) and \(\inf_{P\in\mathcal P_K^{\cup}}P\{L_n\le d(P)\}\ge1-\alpha\).
body.justification: It supplies a fully valid baseline that includes training uncertainty and every active constraint.
body.gap: Wu et al.'s bootstrap result does not state a finite-sample uniform bound over a moving source-and-box image.
body.consumer: Implementers obtain a conservative test and an honest defect lower bound even before the sharp frontier is resolved.
